subject: Trial access sprint recap, success criteria & SSO / IP allowlist request
messages:
From: Emily Rios <emily.rios@skyrise.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood trial — proposed success criteria & next steps

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Really helpful to see the runtime and the cost controls. Per our conversation, here's what I'd like to lock in for the 3-week trial so we can evaluate fit quickly: 

- Success criteria (high level):
  * API gen latency: p95 < 350ms for 128-token requests under our expected concurrency (50-80 rps).
  * Reliability: 99.5% successful responses (no 5xx) during business hours.
  * Cost: projected per-token cost within 15% of Redwood recommendation for our quantized setting.
  * End-to-end eval: 100 score/200 on our relevance rubric for 5 core prompt families (will send rubric).

- Trial scope & timeline:
  * Kickoff & credentials: Week 0 (this week) — SSO invites for product + security, sandbox API key, IP allowlist entries.
  * Integration & runbook steps: Week 1 — smoke tests and two load windows.
  * Evaluation & regression checks: Week 2 — run prompt set and gather metrics.
  * Wrap & decision: Week 3 — share findings, recommended next steps.

Can you provision:
1) SSO (SAML) invite for our product lead (emily.rios@skyrise.ai) and security contact (sec@skyrise.ai)
2) A sandbox API key scoped to the trial project (revocable)
3) IP allowlist entry: 52.24.120.0/24 and 54.172.15.128/27 (our egress)

We'll send a short data sample and the relevance rubric by EOD so you can run the initial eval. Attaching a draft of our trial expectations.

Thanks — Emily

Subject: Re: Redwood trial — proposed success criteria & next steps

Emily — really appreciate the clear success criteria. Confirming we can support the plan and listing immediate next steps from our side: 

What we'll deliver this week (owner in parenthesis):
- Create a sandbox API key scoped to project SKY-2026-142 (Aditya). Key will be time-limited and revocable.
- Provision SSO/SAML test tenant and send metadata/SSO invite (Kimberly). Please share your IdP metadata when you have it; otherwise we'll provide our SP details.
- Add IP allowlist entries per the ranges you sent (Monica).
- Delivery: we'll post the trial runbook and a checklist in the shared drive link and notify when creds are ready.

Quick clarifications:
- For the p95 latency target, is 128 tokens the canonical request size for your eval? (We can also run 64/256 variants if you'd like.)
- For the relevance rubric: please send the rubric + a 30–50 sample prompt set. We'll design the evaluation harness to compute the metric you described.

I'll kick off the SSO thread with our security team and loop in Monica to confirm the IP ranges. Expect the sandbox key and runbook link by end of business tomorrow PST.

Best,
Kimberly Park

kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0137
